login.description: Sign in to the admin panel
login.passwordSet: Your password is set. Sign in with it.

setPassword.title: Set your password
setPassword.description: Choose the password you'll use to sign in to the admin panel.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot your password?
forgotPassword.description: Enter the e-mail you sign in with and we'll send you a link to set a new password.

account.title: Account
account.changePasswordDescription: You stay signed in here; your other devices and apps are signed out.

dashboard.description: Your business month by month, net of VAT.

partial.title: This month is still running
partial.description: The figures so far are a preview and will change until the month ends on {{end}}.

otherCurrencies.title: Also amounts in {{currencies}}
otherCurrencies.description: They are not converted or included in these figures. Open Income or Expenses to see them.

payroll.title: Payroll
payroll.approvedDetail: Gross pay of the approved run.
payroll.draftDetail: An estimate from the draft run. It counts once the run is approved.
payroll.noneDetail: No payroll run for this month yet.

result.title: Result
result.detail: Net income minus net expenses and payroll.
result.detailWithoutPayroll: Net income minus net expenses. Payroll is not counted until the run is approved.

trend.title: Trend
trend.description_one: Net income and costs over the last {{count}} month.
trend.description_other: Net income and costs over the last {{count}} months.
trend.payrollPending: Payroll not approved: not in the costs.
trend.footnote: Costs are net expenses plus approved payroll. Select a month to see its figures.

useTimeclock.noOrganizationDescription: You don't belong to any organization. When a business adds you, you'll get an e-mail invitation.
useTimeclock.title: Use the timeclock
useTimeclock.description: You're an employee of {{organization}}. The admin is for owners and managers; clock in, see your shifts and ask for changes in the timeclock app.
useTimeclock.otherOrganizationsDescription: You can use the admin for these.

hint.notConnected: An owner saves a KSeF token to import purchase invoices.
hint.tokenUnreadable: The saved token can no longer be read. An owner has to save it again.
hint.tokenRejected: KSeF refused the token. An owner has to generate a new one in KSeF and save it.
hint.notChecked: Test the connection to check it.

error.token_unreadable: The saved token can no longer be read.
error.rate_limited: KSeF asked us to slow down. Try again later.
error.unavailable: KSeF could not be reached. Try again later.
error.request_failed: KSeF answered in an unexpected way.
error.invoice_unreadable: Some invoices could not be read and were skipped.

card.description: Purchase invoices are imported from KSeF with a KSeF token generated for the organization's NIP with the InvoiceRead permission only.
card.savedCheckFailed: KSeF token saved, but the check failed
card.tokenDescription: Stored encrypted and never shown again. Saving checks it against KSeF right away.
card.removeDescription: Purchase invoices stop being imported until a new token is saved. Invoices already imported stay.

import.startedDescription: New invoices show up here when it finishes.
import.tooSoon: An import was requested less than 15 minutes ago
import.title: KSeF import
import.never: Purchase invoices are imported from KSeF every night. Nothing was imported yet.
import.waitRateLimited: KSeF asked us to slow down. Available again at {{time}}.
import.noToken: Stopped: no KSeF token is saved.
import.ownerSaves: An owner saves one in Settings.

rejected.title: KSeF import stopped: the token was rejected
rejected.askOwner: Ask an owner to save a new token in Settings.

error.nameTakenByDeactivated: A deactivated register is already named “{{name}}”. Deactivated registers keep their names, so pick another one.

registers.title: Registers
registers.description: Tills with their own fiscal printer. Income is entered per register, one daily report each.
registers.noneActive: No active registers. Add one before entering income.
registers.deactivatedDescription: They take no new entries. Their entries stay on the Income page, under their names.

confirm.title: Deactivate {{name}}?
confirm.description: It takes no new entries from now on. Its existing entries stay on the Income page, and you can still correct them. Registers can't be reactivated, and the name stays taken.

confirmDelete.title: Delete {{name}}?
confirmDelete.description: It has no revenue entries, so nothing else changes. The name becomes free again.

dialog.renameDescription: Its revenue entries, past ones included, show the new name.
dialog.addDescription: A till with its own fiscal printer. You enter one daily report per register.
dialog.name: Name
dialog.nameDescription_one: Up to {{count}} character, different from your other registers.
dialog.nameDescription_other: Up to {{count}} characters, different from your other registers.

paymentMethods.title: Payment methods
paymentMethods.description: How your takings are paid. The entry form and the summaries list them in this order.
paymentMethods.reorderHint: Drag a method by its handle, or focus the handle and use Space and the arrow keys, to change the order.
paymentMethods.noneActive: No active payment methods. Add or reactivate one before entering income.
paymentMethods.deactivatedDescription: They take no new entries. Entries that already use them keep them. Reactivate one to use it again: it goes to the end of the list.

confirmDelete.title: Delete {{name}}?
confirmDelete.description: No entry uses it, so nothing else changes. You can add it again later.

error.nameTaken: A payment method named “{{name}}” already exists.
error.nameTakenByDeactivated: A deactivated payment method is already named “{{name}}”. Reactivate it, or pick another name.
error.deactivate: Could not deactivate the payment method
error.reactivate: Could not reactivate the payment method
error.delete: Could not delete the payment method
error.reorder: Could not save the new order

dialog.renameDescription: Entries and summaries, past ones included, show the new name.
dialog.addDescription: For example meal vouchers, BLIK or a delivery platform. It goes to the end of the list.
dialog.name: Name
dialog.nameDescription_one: Up to {{count}} character, different from your other payment methods.
dialog.nameDescription_other: Up to {{count}} characters, different from your other payment methods.

error.nameTakenByArchived: An archived category is already named “{{name}}”. Restore it, or pick another name.

categories.title: Expense categories
categories.description: What expenses are for, such as rent or drinks. Purchase invoices are sorted into them.
categories.noneActive: No active categories. Add one, or restore an archived one.
categories.archivedDescription: They are not offered for new expenses. Expenses that have one keep it. Restore one to use it again.

toast.archivedDescription: It is no longer offered for new expenses.

dialog.renameDescription: Expenses in this category, past ones included, show the new name.
dialog.addDescription: What an expense was for, such as rent or drinks. You sort purchase invoices into categories.
dialog.nameDescription_one: Up to {{count}} character, different from your other categories.
dialog.nameDescription_other: Up to {{count}} characters, different from your other categories.

change.missingShift: Enters a shift that was not clocked
change.both: Changes the clock-in and the clock-out

shiftRequests.title: Shift change requests
shiftRequests.description: People ask for a shift they forgot to clock, or for new times. Times in {{timeZone}}.
shiftRequests.cardDescription: Newest first. Approving gives the shift the requested times; the shift rules (no overlap, nothing in the future) are checked then.

empty.pending: No requests are waiting for a decision.
empty.all: Nobody has asked for a shift change yet.

dialog.approveMissing: The shift is entered for {{name}}, marked as entered by you.
dialog.approveNewTimes: The shift gets the requested times, marked as corrected by you.
dialog.reject: The shift stays as it is. {{name}} is told by e-mail.
dialog.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. The rota says you left at 02:00.
dialog.stillPending: The request is still pending. Fix the other shift on the Time page, or reject the request.

expenses.title: Expenses
expenses.description: Purchase invoices by issue date. Click one for its details.
expenses.descriptionKsef: Purchase invoices by issue date, imported from KSeF or entered by hand. Click one for its details.
expenses.noneMatching: No expenses match the filters in this period.

sheet.importedFrom: Imported from {{source}}: only the category can be changed.
sheet.noVat: The invoice has no VAT breakdown.
sheet.noDocumentManual: Entered by hand, without a document.
sheet.deleteDescription: {{amount}} leaves the period's totals. A deleted expense can't be restored; you can enter it again.

error.issueDate: Choose the date on the document.
error.currency: Enter a three-letter currency code, e.g. EUR.
error.negative: Only a correction has negative amounts.
error.vatTotal: Enter the VAT total. Enter 0 for a document without VAT.

expenseForm.addDescription: A receipt or an invoice that is not in KSeF, with the amounts as printed.
expenseForm.foreign: VAT is settled in {{currency}}: the breakdown asks for both.
expenseForm.totalsDescription: As printed. Net is gross minus VAT.
expenseForm.totalsDescriptionCorrection: As printed; a correction may be negative. Net is gross minus VAT.
expenseForm.breakdownDescription: Net and VAT per rate, as printed. Leave a rate empty if it isn't on the document.
expenseForm.mismatch: The breakdown doesn't add up to the totals. That's allowed if the document rounds differently.

error.businessDate: Choose the day the daily report covers.
error.futureDate: The day can't be after today.
error.payments: Enter at least one amount. Enter 0 for a register that sold nothing.
error.vatAboveGross: The VAT can't be more than the gross amount.

income.title: Income
income.description: Each register's daily report, by the day it covers. Click an amount to correct it.

noRegister.title: Add a register first
noRegister.description: Income is entered per register, one daily report each. Add the tills with their own fiscal printer, then come back to enter what they took.

days.title: Days
days.none: No days to enter for {{period}} yet.
days.none_month: No days to enter in {{period}} yet.
days.allEntered: Every day so far has at least one entry.
days.missing_one: {{count}} day has no entry yet. An empty cell adds that register's day.
days.missing_other: {{count}} days have no entry yet. An empty cell adds that register's day.
days.vatDiffers: The VAT breakdown differs from the payments by {{amount}}

vat.title: VAT
vat.none: No entry has a VAT breakdown.
vat.description: VAT {{vat}} in a gross {{gross}}, from the daily reports.
vat.grossMore: The VAT gross is {{amount}} more than the payments. Allowed: e.g. invoiced transfers aren't on the fiscal reports.
vat.grossLess: The VAT gross is {{amount}} less than the payments. Allowed: e.g. invoiced transfers aren't on the fiscal reports.

entry.addDescription: One register's daily report: what it took per payment method, and the VAT breakdown if you have it.
entry.fixed: The register and the day don't change: delete the entry and add it again.
entry.deletedMeanwhile: That entry was deleted in the meantime. Try saving again.
entry.paymentsDescription: Gross amounts. Leave a method empty if it wasn't used; 0 is fine.
entry.vatBreakdownDescription: As printed on the register's daily report. You can also add it later.
entry.vatMore: The VAT breakdown is {{amount}} more than the payments. That's allowed, e.g. for a transfer that isn't on the fiscal report.
entry.vatLess: The VAT breakdown is {{amount}} less than the payments. That's allowed, e.g. for a transfer that isn't on the fiscal report.
entry.notePlaceholder: Optional, e.g. an invoiced event paid by transfer
entry.deleteDescription: {{amount}} leaves the month's totals. A deleted entry can't be restored; you can enter the day again.
entry.noPaymentMethods: The organization has no active payment method.
entry.deactivatedMethod: Deactivated: this entry keeps it, but new entries can't use it.

nearest.minutes15: Each shift to the nearest 15 minutes
nearest.minutes30: Each shift to the nearest 30 minutes
nearest.hour: Each shift to the nearest 1 hour

up.minutes15: Each shift rounded up to 15 minutes
up.minutes30: Each shift rounded up to 30 minutes
up.hour: Each shift rounded up to 1 hour

down.minutes15: Each shift rounded down to 15 minutes
down.minutes30: Each shift rounded down to 30 minutes
down.hour: Each shift rounded down to 1 hour

blocker.monthNotOver: The month isn't over yet: this draft is a preview.
blocker.openShifts_one: {{count}} shift is still open. End it on the Time page, then regenerate.
blocker.openShifts_other: {{count}} shifts are still open. End them on the Time page, then regenerate.
blocker.pendingRequests_one: {{count}} shift change request is waiting for a decision. Decide it, then regenerate.
blocker.pendingRequests_other: {{count}} shift change requests are waiting for a decision. Decide them, then regenerate.
blocker.linesWithoutRate_one: {{count}} shift has no rate. Set the rate, then regenerate.
blocker.linesWithoutRate_other: {{count}} shifts have no rate. Set the rate, then regenerate.
blocker.negativeTotals_one: {{count}} paycheck has a negative total. Move part of the deduction to a later month.
blocker.negativeTotals_other: {{count}} paychecks have a negative total. Move part of the deduction to a later month.

error.rateAmount: Enter the gross amount per hour.
error.rateNotPositive: The rate must be more than zero.
error.labelMissing: Say what it is for, e.g. “Bonus” or “Advance paid 10 Oct”.
error.adjustmentAmount: Enter an amount: positive adds to the pay, negative takes off.
error.paidOn: Choose the day it was paid.
error.futureDate: The day can't be after today.

payroll.title: Payroll
payroll.description: Gross pay for a month from the ended shifts and each person's rate. Your accountant does the rest.
payroll.readyOwner: Review the paychecks, then approve. Approving locks the month's shifts and rates.
payroll.readyManager: Review the paychecks. An owner approves the run, which locks the month's shifts and rates.

noRun.thisMonth: This month isn't over. A draft now is a preview: it can be approved once the month has ended.
noRun.pastMonth: Generate a draft from the month's ended shifts and the rates, review it, then an owner approves it.

run.locked: The month's shifts and rates are locked.

toast.reopen: {{period}} reopened as a draft: its shifts are unlocked

confirm.approveDescription_one: {{amount}} gross in {{count}} paycheck. The month's shifts and rates are locked until the run is reopened.
confirm.approveDescription_other: {{amount}} gross in {{count}} paychecks. The month's shifts and rates are locked until the run is reopened.
confirm.reopenDescription: The run goes back to a draft and the month's shifts and rates are unlocked. It has to be approved again.
confirm.deleteDescription: Its paychecks and adjustments are deleted. You can generate the month again.

paychecks.title: Paychecks
paychecks.draft: Click a person to see their shifts and adjustments.
paychecks.markEach: Mark each paycheck paid once the money has left.

lines.roundedMore: Pay for hours is rounded once from the exact time, so it is {{amount}} more than the sum of the shift amounts.
lines.roundedLess: Pay for hours is rounded once from the exact time, so it is {{amount}} less than the sum of the shift amounts.

generate.generateDescription: One paycheck per person with ended shifts this month, one line per shift, at each shift's rate.
generate.regenerateDescription: Rebuilds the paychecks from the current shifts and rates. Adjustments stay.
generate.exact: Shifts are paid to the second.
generate.nearest: To the nearest rounds a half up.

payment.title: Mark paid: {{name}}
payment.description: {{amount}} gross for {{period}}. Once a paycheck is marked paid, the run can't be reopened.
payment.undoFailed: Could not undo the paid mark

paidBy.cash: Paid on {{date}} by cash, marked on {{marked}}.
paidBy.transfer: Paid on {{date}} by transfer, marked on {{marked}}.

adjustment.description: A bonus adds to the month's pay; an advance already paid takes off it. Adjustments stay when the run is regenerated.
adjustment.label: What for
adjustment.amountDescription: Gross. Use a minus for a deduction, e.g. −200.

toast.description: {{name}}: {{amount}} per hour. Regenerate drafts to use it.

rate.hourlyDescription: The usual gross rate per hour from a date until the next rate. Earlier shifts keep the earlier rate.
rate.dayDescription: A different gross rate per hour for the shifts that start on one date, such as New Year's Eve.
rate.lockedDates: Dates in an approved payroll month can't change.

rates.title: Rates
rates.description: Gross pay per hour. A raise is a new rate from a date; earlier shifts keep the earlier rate. A day rate replaces it for the shifts that start on one date.
rates.everyoneHasRate: Everyone has a rate today. Click a person to see their history and day rates.
rates.withoutRate_one: {{count}} person has no rate today: their shifts can't be paid until one is set.
rates.withoutRate_other: {{count}} people have no rate today: their shifts can't be paid until one is set.
rates.deleteDayDescription: {{name}}'s shifts on {{date}} go back to the hourly rate.
rates.deleteHourlyDescription: {{name}}'s shifts from {{date}} go back to the previous rate, or to none.
rates.lockedTitle: In an approved payroll month: reopen the run to change it
rates.locked: Locked by an approved payroll month

team.title: Team
team.description: People with access to this organization.
team.descriptionManager: People with access to this organization. Managers manage employees only.
team.lastOwner: The organization needs at least one active owner.

confirm.deactivateSelfDescription: You will lose access to this organization right away. Another owner can reactivate you.
confirm.deactivateDescription: They lose access to this organization right away, and a pending invitation stops working. Their history stays, and you can reactivate them later.

ownRoleTitle.owner: Change your own role to owner?
ownRoleTitle.manager: Change your own role to manager?
ownRoleTitle.employee: Change your own role to employee?

confirm.ownRoleEmployee: Employees can't manage the team or the organization settings. Only another owner can give you your role back.
confirm.ownRoleDescription: Only another owner can give you your role back.

addMember.title: Add member
addMember.description: New people get an e-mail with a link to set their password. People who already have an account keep their own name and password.

language.label: Language
language.description: Of the invitation e-mail, and the new person's language until they choose one. People who already have an account keep theirs.

error.alreadyMember: {{name}} ({{email}}) is already a member of this organization.
error.deactivatedMember: {{name}} ({{email}}) is a deactivated member. Show deactivated members and reactivate them instead.

time.title: Time tracking
time.description: Shifts by the day they started on. Times in {{timeZone}}.

totals.title: Totals per employee
totals.description: Time worked for {{period}}. An open shift counts once it is clocked out.
totals.description_month: Time worked in {{period}}. An open shift counts once it is clocked out.
totals.none: Nobody worked a shift in this period.

shifts.title: Shifts
shifts.description: Newest first. Open shifts are highlighted; end a forgotten one with End shift.

shiftDialog.addDescription: A shift someone forgot to clock. It is marked as entered by you.
shiftDialog.editDescription: {{name}}, {{date}}. The shift keeps who changed it and when.
shiftDialog.endDescription: {{name}} is still clocked in. Enter the clock-out to end the shift, or leave it empty to keep it open.
shiftDialog.keepOpen: Leave empty to keep the shift open.
shiftDialog.nextDay: The next day: the clock-out is not after the clock-in.
shiftDialog.notePlaceholder: Optional, e.g. why the shift was entered or changed

delete.title: Delete this shift?
delete.description: {{name}}, {{date}}, {{start}}–{{end}} ({{duration}}). The shift is deleted for good: this cannot be undone.

settings.title: Organization settings
settings.description: Used across all modules: invoices, payroll and reports.
settings.name: Business name
settings.taxIdDescription: Needed to fetch purchase invoices from KSeF.
settings.csvDescription: Pick what your spreadsheet expects, e.g. for the payroll export. Excel in Polish or German uses semicolons.
